tasks.design: Configure native part/bin fields and shortage formulas in {ERP}, and selected-line order reuse in {PROCUREMENT}. The repairer counts and handles actual parts, checks stock entries, chooses replenishment and checks the completed supplier order before its separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock maintenance can repeat part references, shortage arithmetic and order entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native stock rules and exact selected-part reuse can reduce those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Actual stock condition, compatibility and repair priorities require physical and technical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The repairer spots a part that is physically present but unsuitable for the intended motor or tool.
tasks.altitude: Less stock arithmetic and repeated entry; counting, handling and purchasing choices remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native inventory rules and purchase-order field reuse can reduce arithmetic and duplicate entry; planned stock or delivery notes alone do not establish actual stock.

assumptions: Repairer creates actual counts in s1 and receipt identity/quantity/condition in s2. Actual issue owner supplies part, quantity, location and event reference for existing issues; repairer captures missing movements and checks all actual entries in retained s3. No free scanning or automatic physical receipt is assumed.

Actual stock-policy owner supplies approved minimums/rules; repair planning supplies actual reservations and purchasing records supply confirmed open orders. Repairer checks relevance in s6, chooses actual quantities and supplies missing supplier fields in retained s7.

Counting, receipts and ordering are actual maintenance branches, not mandatory in every stock check. Shares are provisional, not measured baselines; reweight actual paths. Supplier sending applies only when this repairer has actual purchasing authority; otherwise actual purchaser action is separate with no avoided labour claimed.

Native fields/formulas first; already automated shortages earn zero saving. Routine stock commit and order send each retain one percent. Gates use existing final checks with no added self-approval time; an order is never evidence of receipt.
unknowns: Which stock and order references are typed twice?
Does the repairer actually place supplier orders?
research_questions: Can native stock/order functions reduce repeated work after actual movement capture and compatibility checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual part/bin fields, approved stock rules and supplier order mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual stock entries and exact part/bin destinations; edits require recheck
s7 checked final supplier order, exact parts, quantities, prices, supplier and delivery destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 repeated stock fields + 10 shortage arithmetic + 8*0.50 order entry = 20; minus 1 upkeep = 19. Half eligible gives 10 minus 1 = 9. Actual counts, handling, replenishment judgement, commit and send stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repairers retain actual parts handling and compatibility choices while native stock and order functions may reduce repeated administration.
role.ambitious_version: Validate actual duplicate stock work and purchasing authority before changing parts replenishment.
